get_model_architecture: get the model architecture class and resolved architecture name from a model config
get_resolved_model_impl: get the resolved model implementation type (TRANSFORMERS, MINDSPORE, or SGLANG) from a model config
resolve_transformers_arch: resolve transformers backend architecture for custom or unsupported model architectures
should_async_load: determine if a weight tensor should be loaded asynchronously based on its device type
post_load_weights: run post-processing on model weights after initial weight loading
